description: This file defines jQuery color animation functions, including color parsing, conversion, and CSS hooks for color properties, as well as a color name map.

classes.name: jQuery.Color
classes.description: A class for color manipulation, parsing, and conversion.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses color input in various formats into internal color representation.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Returns color as a hexadecimal string, optionally including alpha.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Blends this color with another to produce an opaque color.
